<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-br">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Dashboard de Qualidade Renault</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;1,9..40,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --bg:#f0f2f5; --surface:#ffffff; --surface2:#f7f8fa; --border:rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  --border-hi:rgba(0,0,0,.16); --text:#141517; --muted:rgba(20,21,23,.50);
  --shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.07), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
  --shadow-lg:0 14px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.13), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  --renault:#EFDF00; --renault-d:#c4b800;
  --orange:#e87621; --grey:#676b70; --blue:#0b376d;
  --good:#20883c; --bad:#d92828; --neutral:#5f6368;
  --r1:#e53935; --r2:#c84d0e; --r3:#f28c28; --r4:#d5a800; --r5:#2e7d32;
  --radius:16px; --radius-sm:10px;
}
* { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }
body { font-family:'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); min-height:100vh; }
body::before { content:''; position:fixed; inset:0; background-image:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,0,0,.055) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size:28px 28px; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; }
.wrap { position:relative; z-index:1; max-width:1840px; margin:0 auto; padding:32px 24px 72px; }
header { background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:var(--shadow); border-radius:var(--radius); padding:24px 28px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:18px; }
.brand-wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; }
.logo { width:74px; height:74px; background:#fff; border-radius:16px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:9px; box-shadow:var(--shadow); border:1px solid var(--border); overflow:hidden; flex:0 0 auto; }
.logo img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; display:block; }
.brand-tag { font-family:'Syne', sans-serif; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; }
h1 { font-family:'Syne', sans-serif; font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,34px); line-height:1.05; margin-top:4px; }
.brand-sub { font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:6px; }
.header-actions { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-end; gap:8px; }
.pill { border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface2); padding:8px 13px; border-radius:999px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); }
.renault-bar { width:110px; height:5px; border-radius:99px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--renault),var(--renault-d)); }
.tabs { display:flex; gap:10px; margin:18px 0; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.tab { border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface); box-shadow:var(--shadow); color:var(--muted); border-radius:var(--radius-sm); padding:12px 22px; font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.1; cursor:pointer; }
.tab.active { background:#111; color:#fff; border-color:#111; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }
.section { display:none; } .section.active { display:block; }
.period-block, .regional-day-block, .boreal-day-block, .nps-model-day-block { margin:18px 0 28px; }
.period-title, .sub-block-title { background:#111; color:#fff; border-radius:12px 12px 0 0; padding:9px 16px; font-family:'Syne', sans-serif; font-weight:900; text-align:center; letter-spacing:.02em; }
.period-range-note { background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--border); border-top:0; padding:7px 12px; color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; text-align:center; }
.current .period-title, .current-title { background:#232323; }
.tables-grid, .regional-tables-row, .boreal-tables-row, .nps-model-tables-row { display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:10px; min-width:max-content; }
.day-scroll { overflow-x:auto; overflow-y:hidden; border:1px solid var(--border); border-top:0; border-radius:0 0 12px 12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.70); padding:0 0 10px 0; }
.day-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { height:12px; }
.day-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:#eceef1; border-radius:999px; }
.day-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:rgba(0,0,0,.30); border-radius:999px; border:3px solid #eceef1; }
.day-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background:rgba(0,0,0,.45); }
.day-scroll table { width:max-content; min-width:100%; }
.day-scroll .kpi-card, .day-scroll .regional-card, .day-scroll .boreal-card, .day-scroll .nps-model-card { flex:0 0 auto; width:max-content; max-width:none; box-shadow:none; }
.summary-day-scroll .kpi-card.vn, .summary-day-scroll .kpi-card.pv { min-width:680px; }
.summary-day-scroll .kpi-card.gmb { min-width:820px; }
.regional-day-scroll .regional-card.vn { min-width:980px; }
.regional-day-scroll .regional-card.pv { min-width:1120px; }
.regional-day-scroll .regional-card.gmb { min-width:1760px; }
.boreal-day-scroll .boreal-card.vn { min-width:5600px; }
.boreal-day-scroll .boreal-card.pv { min-width:4300px; }
.nps-model-day-scroll .nps-model-card.vn { min-width:1800px; }
.nps-model-day-scroll .nps-model-card.pv { min-width:2250px; }
.kpi-card, .regional-card, .boreal-card, .nps-model-card { background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; }
.kpi-card-title, .regional-title { font-family:'Syne', sans-serif; font-weight:900; text-align:center; padding:8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-hi); }
.kpi-card.vn .kpi-card-title, .regional-card.vn .regional-title { background:#f6d96b; }
.kpi-card.pv .kpi-card-title, .regional-card.pv .regional-title { background:#d1d1d1; }
.kpi-card.gmb .kpi-card-title, .regional-card.gmb .regional-title { background:#a7c9e8; }
.regional-title span { font-size:12px; font-family:'DM Sans', sans-serif; color:rgba(0,0,0,.62); }
.table-wrap { overflow:visible; }
table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:12px; }
th, td { border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.22); padding:6px 8px; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle; white-space:nowrap; }
th { font-weight:900; background:#f4f4f4; }
.kpi-col { min-width:190px; } .obj-col { min-width:74px; } .value-col { min-width:78px; } .trend-col { min-width:44px; }
.kpi-name { text-align:left; font-weight:900; }
.objective { color:var(--muted); font-weight:800; }
.num { font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:800; }
.target-ok, .good { color:var(--good); } .target-bad, .bad { color:var(--bad); } .neutral { color:var(--neutral); }
.trend { font-weight:1000; font-size:15px; } .trend.good, .trend-pp.good { color:var(--good); } .trend.bad, .trend-pp.bad { color:var(--bad); }
.trend.up.good, .trend.down.good { color:var(--good); } .trend.up.bad, .trend.down.bad { color:var(--bad); }
.trend-pp { font-weight:900; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
/* Delimita visualmente a transição entre os períodos ativos (D-1, MTD, H2, YTD -Jan ou YTD). */
.period-start { border-left:3px solid rgba(0,0,0,.72) !important; }
.regional-card, .boreal-card, .nps-model-card { margin-bottom:0; border-radius:0 0 12px 12px; }
.regional-table th { background:#f6d96b; } .regional-card.pv .regional-table th { background:#d1d1d1; } .regional-card.gmb .regional-table th { background:#a7c9e8; }
.boreal-card.vn .regional-title, .boreal-card.vn .boreal-table th { background:#f6d96b; }
.boreal-card.pv .regional-title, .boreal-card.pv .boreal-table th { background:#d1d1d1; }
.boreal-table { font-size:10.5px; }
.boreal-table th { line-height:1.18; padding:6px 5px; }
.boreal-table td { padding:5px 6px; }
/* Painel lateral congelado da tabela Boreal.
   O sticky é limitado ao próprio card: ao terminar VN, o painel de PV assume. */
.day-scroll .boreal-card { overflow:visible; }
.boreal-table .sticky-group {
  position:sticky; left:0; min-width:92px; width:92px; z-index:5;
  box-shadow:2px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.boreal-table .sticky-region {
  position:sticky; left:92px; min-width:82px; width:82px; z-index:4;
  box-shadow:2px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.boreal-table thead .sticky-head { z-index:9; }
.boreal-card.vn .boreal-table thead .sticky-head { background:#f6d96b; }
.boreal-card.pv .boreal-table thead .sticky-head { background:#d1d1d1; }
.boreal-table tbody .sticky-region { background:#fafafa; }
/* Destaque do total Brasil em cada grupo. */
.boreal-table tr.brazil-total-row > td:not(.segment-name) {
  background:#fff2a8; font-weight:1000;
}
.boreal-table tr.brazil-total-row > td.sticky-region { background:#fff2a8; }
.segment-name { font-weight:1000; min-width:92px; background:#ececec; }
.segment-boreal { background:#fff2a8; }
.segment-minus { background:#f5f5f5; }
.share-cell { color:var(--text) !important; }
/* Aba NPS por Modelo. A coluna Modelo acompanha a rolagem somente dentro de sua tabela. */
.day-scroll .nps-model-card { overflow:visible; }
.nps-model-card.vn .regional-title, .nps-model-card.vn .nps-model-table th { background:#f6d96b; }
.nps-model-card.pv .regional-title, .nps-model-card.pv .nps-model-table th { background:#d1d1d1; }
.nps-model-table { font-size:11px; }
.nps-model-table th { line-height:1.18; padding:6px 6px; }
.nps-model-table td { padding:5px 7px; }
.nps-model-table .sticky-model {
  position:sticky; left:0; min-width:138px; width:138px; z-index:5;
  box-shadow:2px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}
.nps-model-table thead .sticky-model-head { z-index:9; }
.nps-model-card.vn .nps-model-table thead .sticky-model-head { background:#f6d96b; }
.nps-model-card.pv .nps-model-table thead .sticky-model-head { background:#d1d1d1; }
.nps-model-table tbody .sticky-model { background:#fafafa; }
.nps-model-table .model-name { font-weight:1000; text-align:left; }
.nps-model-card.vn tr.total-model-row > td { background:#fff2a8; font-weight:1000; }
.nps-model-card.pv tr.total-model-row > td { background:#c9c9c9; font-weight:1000; }
.nps-model-card.pv tr.focus-model-row > td { background:#e5e5e5; }
.nps-model-card.vn tr.total-model-row > td.sticky-model { background:#fff2a8; }
.nps-model-card.pv tr.total-model-row > td.sticky-model { background:#c9c9c9; }
.nps-model-card.pv tr.focus-model-row > td.sticky-model { background:#e5e5e5; }
.region-name { font-weight:1000; background:#fafafa; }
.gmb-table { font-size:11px; }
.filter-bar { background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius); box-shadow:var(--shadow); padding:14px 16px; display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px; margin:16px 0; }
.filter-label { font-size:11px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); }
.chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:8px; border:1.5px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface2); font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.1; cursor:pointer; }
.chip.active { background:#111; color:white; border-color:#111; }
.search { padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; border:1.5px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface2); font-family:'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; outline:none; min-width:260px; }
.model-chips { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:7px; width:100%; padding-top:6px; }
.count { margin-left:auto; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.cards-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,620px),1fr)); gap:14px; }
.review-card { background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius); box-shadow:var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; position:relative; transition:.2s transform,.2s box-shadow; }
.review-card[data-source="Vendas"] { background:#fffaf0; border-color:rgba(214,143,26,.18); }
.review-card[data-source="Pós-Venda"] { background:#f1f2f4; border-color:rgba(95,99,104,.18); }
.review-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }
.review-card::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:4px; }
.review-card[data-rating="1"]::before { background:var(--r1); } .review-card[data-rating="2"]::before { background:var(--r2); } .review-card[data-rating="3"]::before { background:var(--r3); } .review-card[data-rating="4"]::before { background:var(--r4); } .review-card[data-rating="5"]::before { background:var(--r5); }
.review-card[data-expandable="true"] { cursor:zoom-in; }
.review-card[data-expandable="true"]:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35); outline-offset:3px; }
.card-head { padding:20px 22px 16px 28px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; }
.card-title { font-family:'Syne', sans-serif; font-weight:900; font-size:20px; letter-spacing:.04em; }
.card-unit { font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:7px; line-height:1.45; }
.work-tag { display:inline-flex; margin-top:8px; background:#f2f3f5; border:1px solid var(--border-hi); border-radius:7px; padding:6px 10px; font-weight:900; color:#2b2b2b; }
.scores-col { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; align-items:flex-end; min-width:260px; }
.score-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; }
.score-label { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; min-width:150px; text-align:right; }
.score-badge { border-radius:8px; padding:6px 10px; font-size:12px; font-weight:900; background:#f2f2f2; color:var(--neutral); border:1px solid rgba(95,99,104,.20); min-width:92px; text-align:center; }
.score-badge.r1 { background:#fff0f0; color:var(--r1); border-color:rgba(229,57,53,.26); }
.score-badge.r2 { background:#fff0e8; color:var(--r2); border-color:rgba(200,77,14,.28); }
.score-badge.r3 { background:#fff4e5; color:var(--r3); border-color:rgba(242,140,40,.36); }
.score-badge.r4 { background:#fff9d9; color:var(--r4); border-color:rgba(213,168,0,.38); }
.score-badge.r5 { background:#edf7ef; color:var(--r5); border-color:rgba(46,125,50,.28); }
.card-body { padding:18px 22px 22px 28px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:15px; }
.comment-block + .comment-block { border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding-top:15px; }
.comment-tag { font-size:11px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); }
.comment-tag::before { content:'•'; color:var(--renault-d); margin-right:8px; font-size:18px; vertical-align:-2px; }
.comment-text { font-size:15px; line-height:1.62; color:rgba(20,21,23,.76); margin-top:7px; }
.review-modal { display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100000; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:2.5vh 2.5vw; }
.review-modal.active { display:flex; }
.review-modal-backdrop { position:absolute; inset:0; background:rgba(10,11,12,.78); backdrop-filter:blur(5px); }
.review-modal-dialog { position:relative; z-index:1; width:min(95vw,1500px); max-height:94vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 28px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.40); }
.review-modal-toolbar { position:relative; z-index:4; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; margin:0; padding:0 2px 12px; flex:0 0 auto; }
.review-modal-copy, .review-modal-close { height:48px; border:0; background:#111; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.28); font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:900; }
.review-modal-copy { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; min-width:168px; padding:0 18px; border-radius:999px; font-size:14px; white-space:nowrap; }
.review-modal-copy:hover, .review-modal-close:hover { background:#292929; }
.review-modal-copy:disabled { cursor:wait; opacity:.78; }
.review-modal-copy.success { background:#20883c; }
.review-modal-copy.fallback { background:#9a5a00; }
.review-modal-copy.error { background:#b42323; }
.review-modal-copy-icon { font-size:19px; line-height:1; }
.review-modal-close { width:48px; border-radius:999px; font-size:30px; line-height:1; flex:0 0 48px; }
.review-modal-content { clear:none; overflow:auto; flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; border-radius:20px; }
.review-modal .review-card { width:100%; min-height:min(78vh,900px); border-radius:20px; cursor:default; transform:none !important; box-shadow:none; }
.review-modal .review-card::before { width:9px; }
.review-modal .card-head { padding:42px 54px 32px 62px; gap:36px; }
.review-modal .card-title { font-size:clamp(30px,3.2vw,48px); }
.review-modal .card-unit { font-size:clamp(16px,1.45vw,22px); margin-top:12px; }
.review-modal .work-tag { font-size:16px; padding:9px 13px; margin-top:12px; }
.review-modal .scores-col { min-width:360px; gap:12px; padding-right:22px; }
.review-modal .score-row { gap:14px; }
.review-modal .score-label { min-width:205px; font-size:17px; }
.review-modal .score-badge { min-width:135px; padding:10px 14px; font-size:17px; }
.review-modal .card-body { padding:34px 54px 48px 62px; gap:26px; }
.review-modal .comment-block + .comment-block { padding-top:26px; }
.review-modal .comment-tag { font-size:14px; }
.review-modal .comment-text { font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,32px); line-height:1.55; margin-top:12px; color:rgba(20,21,23,.88); }
body.review-modal-open { overflow:hidden; }
/* Ranking e linha do tempo das concessionárias. */
.dealer-section { font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif; }
.dealer-subtab-control { position:absolute; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; }
.dealer-subtabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin:0 0 14px; }
.dealer-subtabs label { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:40px; padding:10px 17px; border:1px solid var(--border-hi); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--muted); box-shadow:var(--shadow); font:900 12px 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; }
#dealer-tab-top:checked ~ .dealer-subtabs label[for="dealer-tab-top"],
#dealer-tab-flop:checked ~ .dealer-subtabs label[for="dealer-tab-flop"],
#dealer-tab-vn:checked ~ .dealer-subtabs label[for="dealer-tab-vn"],
#dealer-tab-pv:checked ~ .dealer-subtabs label[for="dealer-tab-pv"],
#dealer-tab-gmb:checked ~ .dealer-subtabs label[for="dealer-tab-gmb"],
#dealer-tab-d1-history:checked ~ .dealer-subtabs label[for="dealer-tab-d1-history"],
#dealer-tab-search:checked ~ .dealer-subtabs label[for="dealer-tab-search"] { background:#111; color:#fff; border-color:#111; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }
.dealer-subsection { display:none; }
#dealer-tab-top:checked ~ .dealer-subsections #dealer-top,
#dealer-tab-flop:checked ~ .dealer-subsections #dealer-flop,
#dealer-tab-vn:checked ~ .dealer-subsections #dealer-vn,
#dealer-tab-pv:checked ~ .dealer-subsections #dealer-pv,
#dealer-tab-gmb:checked ~ .dealer-subsections #dealer-gmb,
#dealer-tab-d1-history:checked ~ .dealer-subsections #dealer-d1-history,
#dealer-tab-search:checked ~ .dealer-subsections #dealer-search { display:block; }
.dealer-ranking-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(660px,1fr)); gap:12px; align-items:start; }
.dealer-ranking-card, .dealer-timeline-panel, .dealer-search-panel { background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; }
.dealer-ranking-title { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:11px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-hi); font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-weight:900; }
.dealer-ranking-title span { letter-spacing:.05em; }
.dealer-ranking-title small { font:800 10px 'DM Sans',sans-serif; color:rgba(0,0,0,.58); }
.dealer-ranking-card.vn .dealer-ranking-title { background:#f6d96b; }
.dealer-ranking-card.pv .dealer-ranking-title { background:#d1d1d1; }
.dealer-ranking-card.top { border-top:4px solid var(--good); }
.dealer-ranking-card.flop { border-top:4px solid var(--bad); }
.dealer-table-scroll { overflow:auto; max-width:100%; }
.dealer-ranking-table, .dealer-timeline-table { min-width:100%; width:max-content; font-size:11.5px; }
.dealer-ranking-table th { background:#f4f4f4; line-height:1.18; }
.dealer-ranking-table .dealer-name { min-width:245px; }
.dealer-position { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-weight:1000; font-size:14px; }
.dealer-name { text-align:left; font-weight:900; }
.dealer-empty { padding:30px 18px; color:var(--muted); text-align:center; }
.dealer-channel-heading { border-radius:12px 12px 0 0; padding:10px 14px; text-align:center; font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-weight:900; }
.dealer-channel-heading.vn { background:#f6d96b; }
.dealer-channel-heading.pv { background:#d1d1d1; }
